data.name: Capital Link Green
data.description: Capital Link Green (CLG) produces biochar via pyrolysis of waste biomass and issues carbon removal credits. The company markets credits verified under Isometric methodology and insured against reversal via Oka/Lloyd's of London. Biochar products target applications including agriculture, water filtration, cement blending, and mine remediation.
